title: A new model and more predictable model handling
summary:
A new text-and-image model, intact JSON Schema requests, and a model list that no longer offers what it can’t serve.

Added `openai-roblox`, a GPT-4.1-mini model that accepts text and images and supports tools. The same PR changed Roblox-referrer routing to use llamascout regardless of the requested model, preserved the first existing system message in model context wrappers, updated Phi-4 Instruct’s listed provider, and adjusted spacing instructions for the hypnosisTracy persona.

The OpenAI-compatible endpoint now forwards the complete `response_format` object to compatible models, including a supplied JSON schema. JSON mode requests without `response_format` still fall back to `{ "type": "json_object" }`.

Removed `llama-vision` from the text API’s available models list, so it is no longer advertised as a text-and-image option.

highlights.title: OpenAI Roblox model added
highlights.text: `openai-roblox` accepts text and image input, produces text, and supports tools. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-roblox).
